name: concurrent activation admits one user into the twentieth slot
verify:
SELECT json_build_object('ok',
(SELECT count(*)=20 FROM public.profiles WHERE is_active AND deleted_at IS NULL)
AND (SELECT count(*)=1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id IN ('91000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020','91000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021') AND is_active)
AND (SELECT active_users=20 FROM private.user_capacity),
'activeUsers',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE is_active AND deleted_at IS NULL));

name: concurrent production cannot consume the same final billet twice
verify:
SELECT json_build_object('ok',
(SELECT count(*)=1 FROM public.rod_production WHERE company_id='80000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
AND (SELECT available_billets=0 FROM private.stock_balances WHERE company_id='80000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
AND (SELECT available_billets=0 FROM public.billet_stock WHERE company_id='80000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),
'outputs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.rod_production WHERE company_id='80000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'),
'availableBillets',(SELECT available_billets FROM private.stock_balances WHERE company_id='80000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'));
